class.name: NNBTLimiter
class.brief_description: Ticks its first enabled behaviour tree child for [member max_repeat_times] and then returns -1 (failure) until the node is reset.
class.description: The limiter node ticks its first enabled behaviour tree child for [member max_repeat_times] and then returns -1 (failure) until the node is reset. Only the first enabled behaviour tree child is ticked. Any additional enabled behaviour tree children are ignored, and the node reports a one-time error the first time it is ticked with more than one enabled behaviour tree child.

members.member: The maximum times the limiter node can be ticked.
